snippets.title: Dev Stack
snippets.rawCode:
version: '3.8'

services:
  web:
    image: node:18-alpine
    container_name: workbench-web-dev
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
      - .:/app
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=development
      - PORT=3000
    command: npm run dev
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - db

  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: workbench-db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: devuser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: devpassword
      POSTGRES_DB: workbench_dev
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: workbench-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

volumes:
  pgdata:
    driver: local

snippets.title: Deploy Vercel
snippets.rawCode:
#!/bin/bash

# Exit immediately if a command exits with a non-zero status
set -e

echo "🚀 Starting deployment prep for CodeSnippet-Workbench..."

# 1. Run local snippet indexer
echo "📂 Running python snippets indexer..."
if command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
    python3 indexer/index-snippets.py
elif command -v python &>/dev/null; then
    python indexer/index-snippets.py
else
    echo "❌ Error: Python is not installed. Indexing aborted."
    exit 1
fi

# 2. Check build output
if [ ! -f "snippets-db.json" ]; then
    echo "❌ Error: snippets-db.json was not generated!"
    exit 1
fi
echo "✓ snippets-db.json generated successfully."

# 3. Trigger Vercel deploy
echo "⚡ Invoking Vercel CLI..."
if command -v vercel &>/dev/null; then
    # Deploy to production and bypass confirmation
    vercel --prod --yes
    echo "🎉 Deployment successfully pushed to Vercel!"
else
    echo "⚠️ Warning: Vercel CLI not found. Please run 'npm i -g vercel' and deploy manually."
    echo "Static files are ready at root directory."
fi
